in_sanskrit.name: Parshurama
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who wields an axe, Rama. Parshurama is a legendary avatar of the god Vishnu, who is said to have appeared on earth to destroy the wicked Kshatriyas.

in_hindi.name: परशुराम
in_hindi.long_meaning: He who holds an axe, Parshurama. Parshurama is a popular name in India, and is also the name of a famous Jain Tirthankara.

in_telugu.name: పరశురామ
in_telugu.long_meaning: He who holds a supreme weapon, Parshurama. Parshurama is a name of reverence in Hindu mythology and is also the name of a Jain Tirthankara.

in_marathi.name: Parshotam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Supreme Lord, Ruler
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parshotam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Parshotam is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit words 'paras' meaning supreme and 'tam' meaning lord or ruler. This name signifies the supreme ruler or the ultimate power in Hindu mythology.
